# Copilot Repository Instructions

Always treat `AGENTS.md` in the repository root as the primary project policy file.

Before any non-trivial task:
- Read `AGENTS.md`.
- Follow the constraints and workflow defined there.

If `AGENTS.md` conflicts with any other project documentation:
- Prioritize `AGENTS.md`.
- Still follow higher-level system safety policies.

Do not perform actions restricted by `AGENTS.md` without explicit user approval.

When requirements are unclear, ask for clarification instead of making assumptions.

Source of truth for repository workflow: `AGENTS.md`.
